描述_EN: 'flower cup' is a term that appears repeatedly in novels of the ming dynasty (1368-1644). the present example is probably one such object. its peculiar shape suggests that it was more of a decorative piece than a vessel with a practical function. although the carved flowers and foliage look very attractive, the cup would probably be rather uncomfortable to hold.
